# isme.gg

> A decentralized, ad-free streaming app for Android and Android TV. Watch history and playback settings stay on your device. Browse movies, Filipino cinema, TV series, anime and K-drama, and stream media you have permission to watch.

## Information
- [Website](https://bastilavarias.github.io/isme.gg/): product features, supported device targets and category overview.
- [How P2P streaming works](https://bastilavarias.github.io/isme.gg/#technology) explains BitTorrent playback, the token-protected on-device connection and HTTPS encryption for catalog requests.
- [FAQ](https://bastilavarias.github.io/isme.gg/#faq): content availability, privacy, platform support and advertising.
- [Project releases](https://github.com/bastilavarias/isme.gg/releases): available builds and release details.

## Accuracy notes
Streaming-platform references are for discovery. The service names and marks belong to their respective owners. Media availability depends on authorized sources and region. Peer-to-peer networking can expose IP addresses.
